reviews.evidence: Comprehensive local agent with automation, IM, memory, sandboxing, task screenshots, prompt scenarios, tests, and diagnostics.
reviews.concern: Most user operations beyond basic chat are summarized rather than walked through end to end.

reviews.evidence: Interactive reply UI has install verification, JSON examples, real video/screenshots, limits, tests, migrations, and recovery guidance.
reviews.concern: Scenarios are mostly concise prompts and component showcases, not detailed real-world case studies.

reviews.evidence: Model gateway covers routing, profiles, tokens, remote bots, SDK examples, OAuth, Web UI, analytics, and several screenshots.
reviews.concern: Reliability evidence is useful but lacks concrete test results and detailed failure behavior.

reviews.evidence: Daily-curated catalog provides a nine-part taxonomy, canonical links, inclusion criteria, and independently verified references.
reviews.concern: No use-case scenarios; navigation is category anchors rather than search or filtering tools.

reviews.evidence: Offline HarmonyOS reference workflow spans task indexes, automation scripts, six explicit scenarios, safety boundaries, and validation commands.
reviews.concern: The README shows no concrete generated result, command output, or meaningful product screenshot.

reviews.evidence: End-to-end audit and authorized pentest platform has detailed CLI/TUI workflows, IDE demos, reports, scope gates, tests, and recovery controls.
reviews.concern: Demos emphasize TUI/IDE scanning; Spear report and PoC outcomes are described rather than shown.

reviews.evidence: Broad trading and wallet workflows include many concrete prompts, multi-network coverage, a 76-scenario benchmark, security notes, and fallbacks.
reviews.concern: No worked transaction output or UI demo; financial operation limits and failure handling are sparse.

reviews.evidence: Paper ingestion flows from PDF/URL through summaries, study artifacts, code notebooks, indexed storage, and a demonstrated web viewer.
reviews.concern: Few explicit scenarios, and no troubleshooting or concrete end-to-end study outcome is shown.

reviews.evidence: Exceptional typed EasyEDA workflow shows requirement-to-schematic/PCB cases, real GIFs, quantified gates, artifacts, recovery, and candid limits.
reviews.concern: Dense routing, programmable undo, impedance data, and turnkey autorouting remain limited.

reviews.evidence: Desktop DSH distribution adds plugin management, archives, model controls, screenshots, checksums, safe mode, diagnostics, and loopback isolation.
reviews.concern: No followable agent task; guidance mostly stops at launching or building the app.
